svg.title: Auto-UV lifecycle and the next-tier loop
svg.desc: Setup and first baseline lead to finite tier searches and automatic final verification. Ordinary tier errors continue; hard exits retain already completed profiles.

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: User starts one tier or all three

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Prepare through the daemon
Validate workloads + editable V/F
Consume markers; reset stock offsets

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Restore checkpoint + power policy
Skip fresh baseline / descent

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
02 · First passing baseline
Stock + bounded clock retreat

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Prepare the current tier
Efficiency → Balanced → Performance
Apply policy; reuse / measure baseline

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: No new result; report the error

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
03 · Finite voltage descent
Performance may reuse
matching Balanced descent

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
04 · Tier / custom clock search
Exact plans; fresh blacklist

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
05 · Select → verify → save
Retry safer tested points
Pass or exhaust the finite pool
